SELECT T1.wilayah AS wilayah,
       T1.periode AS periode,
       T1.nilai
FROM nilai_indikator AS T1
WHERE T1.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T1.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1);

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.kode AS wilayah,
    T1.nama AS periode,
    T2.nilai AS nilai
FROM 
    provinsi AS T1
JOIN 
    nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE 
    T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND T2.periode = :periode
    AND T2.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)
ORDER BY 
    T2.nilai DESC

SELECT
    T1.nama AS wilayah,
    T2.periode,
    T3.nilai
FROM
    provinsi AS T1
JOIN
    nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
JOIN
    indikator AS T3 ON T2.kode_indikator = T3.kode
WHERE
    T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND T2.periode = :periode
    AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)

value.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.nilai AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T2.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)
ORDER BY T2.nilai DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = '36' -- Kode indikator: PIB
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN ('01', '02') -- Kode provinsi: Sulawesi Selatan, Sulawesi Utara
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    nilai_indikator.periode AS periode,
    CASE
        WHEN nilai_indikator.nilai IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        ELSE nilai_indikator.nilai
    END AS nilai
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)
ORDER BY
    nilai ASC;
